header: Six kinds of business, one rota problem
lead: The rules differ, the shape of the week differs, and the argument for getting off paper is the same everywhere.

cases.title: Retail chains
cases.description: Trading hours that move with the season, and a Saturday that has to be covered twice over.

cases.title: Hospitality
cases.description: Split shifts, late closes and a rota that changes after the weather forecast does.

cases.title: Care homes
cases.description: Qualification cover on every shift and a night rota that never has any slack in it.

cases.title: Facility services
cases.description: Staff spread across client sites, clocking in somewhere different every morning.

cases.title: Logistics depots
cases.description: Peaks announced a fortnight out and driving-time rules on top of working-time ones.

cases.title: Garden centres
cases.description: Four months of the year at double staffing and eight at a skeleton crew.
